receipt.name: WarmNormalOrientation
receipt.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA8 raster with Normal orientation copied into an independent owned 513x259 raster at the same depth. Complete public AutoOrient, admission, allocation, full materialization and disposal. Native public FFmpeg null graph emits a shared view; av_frame_get_buffer plus av_frame_copy allocates and materializes an independent raster inside every operation before release. Graph/source/frame wrappers are reused. Native padded rows exposed directly; one necessary owned copy, no redundant packing copy. Exact complete channel bytes, alpha and hidden RGB; no output cache. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this original raster is measured.

Only this original whole raster is measured.
